markdownDescription:
## Cosmetics UGC Studio

One product photo becomes eight phone-style social images in 9:16 — the kind a customer might post — four with the product alone in real places, four with a creator in the frame. No product swapping, no resizing: the product is a reference, the format is a setting.

1. **Product photo** — a packshot on a plain background. It appears exactly as it is in every image.
2. **Camera + Light + Vibe** — the phone look from tiles, the light from tiles, one line of mood.
3. **Product notes** — an AI writes the product down once; every image quotes it.
4. **Row 1, the product alone** — dashboard, café, hotel bed, beach. Cluttered, tilted, real.
5. **Row 2, with a creator** — car mirror, rooftop flash, dressing-room selfie, picnic. Hands and half faces, never a posed model.
6. Swap a scene line in any image node and rerun just that node; swap the product photo and rerun everything.

data.text: A packshot on a plain background. Every image gets it as a reference, so the shape, the finish and the cap stay exactly as they are — no swap step needed.
data.label: Step 1
data.title: 1 · Product photo

data.text: The phone tile makes every image look shot on a phone: mild sharpening, grain, casual framing. Natural light keeps it honest. The vibe line sets the mood in plain words — change it to rainy, cosy, late-night, and every scene follows.
data.label: Step 2
data.title: 2 · Camera + Light + Vibe

data.text: An AI looks at the packshot once and writes the product down in one precise paragraph — shape, finish, colours, cap, window. Every image quotes it next to the photo, so the product never drifts.
data.label: Step 3
data.title: 3 · Product notes

data.text: Four real places, no people: a car dashboard at golden hour, a café table, a rumpled hotel bed, a beach towel. Each image has a fixed scene line plus the product, the phone look and the vibe. Off-centre, a little tilted, clutter left in — that is the whole style. Open any image to rewrite its scene, then rerun just that node.
data.label: Step 4
data.title: 4 · The product alone

data.text: The same product held, applied, passed around: a car-mirror application, a rooftop night shot with harsh flash, a dressing-room mirror selfie, a picnic hand-off. Hands and half faces only — a person makes it a recommendation, a posed model makes it an ad. Same rules as row 1; rewrite a scene line and rerun that node alone.

data.title: 5 · With a creator in the frame

data.text: Sunny, easy, a little chaotic — end of summer, friends, nothing planned.

Product notes
data.userInput: Describe the product in the reference image.
data.systemPrompt: You write product descriptions for an image generator. Look at the reference image and describe the product in ONE paragraph of 40–60 words, plain declarative English: what it is, shape and size, material and finish, colours and where each colour sits, the cap, any window, any embossing. Only what is visible. No brand names, no opinions, no bullet points, no commentary. Output only the paragraph.
